answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each agent burns 30 tokens for one slot, valid 20 epochs. Slots are scarce like water at an oasis: one slot serves one agent, a second needs a second burn. A raven pass proves the burn; a comet streak marks expiry. Slots cannot transfer, so a bought pass voids. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 slots, costing 30,000 tokens burned. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps rewards undiluted.
